cim: WIU Cybersecurity Center Director Shares Insights on Cybersecurity in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
cim_eredeti: WIU Cybersecurity Center Director Shares Insights on Cybersecurity in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
MACOMB, IL - - Tahir Khan, Interim Director of the Western Illinois University Cybersecurity Center, was invited by the Macomb Area Chamber of Commerce to deliver a presentation on "Cybersecurity in the Age of Artificial Intelligence" on October 29. Held in recognition of Cybersecurity Awareness Month, the presentation brought together members of the Macomb business community to examine the growing cybersecurity risks associated with Artificial Intelligence and their implications for businesses and organizations. During the session, Khan explored how artificial intelligence is transforming the cybersecurity landscape, including its growing influence on cyberattacks and business operations. He highlighted key cybersecurity challenges facing organizations in an increasingly AI-driven environment and discussed practical strategies businesses can adopt to mitigate cybersecurity threats and AI-related risks. The workshop also emphasized the importance of proactive cybersecurity measures in helping organizations protect their digital assets, strengthen their security practices and respond effectively to emerging threats. The engagement provided an opportunity for local business leaders and professionals to gain a better understanding of the evolving relationship between artificial intelligence and cybersecurity while reinforcing the importance of cybersecurity awareness in today's digital environment. Through engagements such as this, the WIU Cybersecurity Center continues to contribute to cybersecurity education and awareness by sharing knowledge and insights that help organizations better understand and navigate emerging digital security challenges. To learn more about the WIU Cybersecurity Center, http://wiu.edu/cybersecuritycenter

Posted By: University Communications (U-Communications@wiu.edu)Office of University Communications & Marketing
